transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Well, I suppose what brings me in is... I keep hearing these voices. Very clear voices. 

Mostly it happens in my apartment, but sometimes I hear them when I'm in empty museum rooms, too. It sounds exactly like women whispering from right behind the walls... and they keep telling me which photographs belong in the archive. It's just very clear, and it's been happening enough that I felt I needed to come in and talk to someone about it.
How long have you been hearing these voices?

It's been about eight months now. That's how long I've been hearing the voices, and... well, along with that, I've had this absolute certainty that people are watching my archive. So, yes, right around eight months.
Over these past eight months, have you been experiencing persistent feelings of depression or sadness?
No, I haven't. I haven't really felt sad or... depressed at all, no. Honestly, my mood has been fine. It's really just the voices and the watching that I've been dealing with.
Do you use any recreational drugs, alcohol, or take any regular medications?
No, I don't use any drugs or drink alcohol. And I'm not on any regular medications either.
Have you been diagnosed with any general medical or neurological conditions?
No, I haven't. I don't have any medical conditions, and my brain... neurologically, everything is fine. I'm generally pretty healthy, aside from what we've been talking about.
